test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following is a quadratic equation?

A. x(x - 4) = 2x + x² - 7

B. 5 (2y + 3) - 6y = 5y(y² - 8y)

C. k(k + 1) - k(k - 2) 2k = 0

D. p(p² + 7) = p² + p³ - 18
solution:
**Concept Used:**

Quadratic equation = ax² + bx + c

**Calculation:**

Take Equation A

⇒ x(x - 4) = 2x + x2 - 7

⇒ x² -4x = 2x + x² - 7

⇒ 6x - 7 = 0

On comparing with ax² + bx + c.

This is not a quadratic equation.

Take Equation B

⇒ 5 (2y + 3) - 6y = 5y(y2 - 8y)

⇒ 10y + 15 - 6y = 5y³ - 40y²

⇒ 5y³ - 40y² - 4y -15 = 0

On comparing with ax2 + bx + c.

This is not a quadratic equation.

Take Equation C

⇒ k(k + 1) - k(k - 2) 2k = 0

⇒ k² + k - 2k³ - 4k² = 0

⇒ -2k³ - 3k² + k = 0

On comparing with ax2 + bx + c.

This is not a quadratic equation.

Take Equation D

⇒ p(p2 + 7) = p2 + p3 - 18

⇒ p³ + 7p = p² + p³ -18

⇒ p² - 7p - 18 = 0

On comparing with ax2 + bx + c.

This is a quadratic equation.

Since, Equation D is the quadratic equation, but it is listed on option (1)

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
